title: Add Goals Resource and Update Agents Md
description: Verify mcp goals resource exists and lists all goals; adjust AGENTS.md so agents must list goals before starting a ticket.
summary: Reverted incorrectly added `goal list`/`goal tree` cobra subcommands; goals are exposed as the MCP resource `repo://goals` (handleGoalsResource), not as a CLI command. Added TestGoalsMcpResource that calls the handler directly and asserts URI, MIME type, non-empty YAML body, and that every seeded goal title appears in the response. Strengthened TestGoalList to assert non-empty `[]*Goal` and fixed pre-existing TestGoalListIDs (wrong type assertion and wrong expected ID shape). AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md updated to require reading `repo://goals` before opening a ticket.
